forms.label: Forms of the organization

empty.title: No forms
empty.note: A form gives you a submission address to put on your site.

forms.name: Form name

address.title: Submission address

address.suspended: This form refuses new messages. Received messages stay in the inbox.

details.title: Name and business
details.noBusiness: No business described. The relevance of messages is not evaluated.
details.new: The form gets a submission address when it is created. The address never changes.

redirect.title: Redirect after submission
redirect.confirmationPage: After a submission from an HTML form, the visitor sees the Rondyr confirmation page. $t(inbox.forms.redirect.origin)

refusals.invalid-url: Enter a full URL, for example https://www.example.com/thanks.
refusals.not-https: The URL must start with https://.
refusals.credentials: Remove the username and password from the URL.
refusals.origin-not-listed: First add the origin of this URL to the allowed origins of the form.

honeypot.title: Honeypot field
honeypot.instructions: Add a text field with this name to your form, hidden with CSS, with tabindex="-1" and autocomplete="off". Visitors leave it empty. A message that fills it goes to review without analysis.
honeypot.name: Honeypot field name

turnstile.title: Turnstile
turnstile.description: Use the site key and secret key from your Cloudflare Turnstile widget.
turnstile.embed: Paste this HTML inside your form. Load the script only once per page.
turnstile.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select and copy the HTML above.
turnstile.secretsKeyMissing: Set RONDYR_SECRETS_KEY on the Worker to enable Turnstile.
turnstile.secretKeyRefused: Cloudflare doesn’t recognize this secret key. Copy it again from the widget’s settings in the Cloudflare dashboard.
turnstile.siteverifyUnavailable: Cloudflare couldn’t check the secret key, so nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.

suspension.title: Suspension
suspension.description: A suspended form refuses new messages with status 403. Received messages, destinations and the submission address are kept.

problems.notAdded: The form could not be added. Check the fields and try again.
problems.notChanged: The form could not be changed. Check the fields and try again.
problems.statusNotChanged: The status could not be changed. Try again.
problems.redirectNotSaved: The redirect could not be saved. Try again.
problems.honeypotNotSaved: The honeypot field could not be saved. Check the name and try again.

domains.description: Declare up to {{limit}} domains for this organization. The classifier checks whether a submitted email address uses one of these domains or a subdomain.
domains.invalid: Enter a lowercase domain name such as example.com, without a scheme or path.
domains.limit: This organization already has {{limit}} domains. Remove one before adding another.
domains.loadFailed: Could not load the organization’s domains.
domains.addFailed: Could not add the domain. Try again.
domains.removeFailed: Could not remove the domain. Try again.

apiTokens.description: Use API tokens to read this inbox and resolve quarantined messages from another application.
apiTokens.name: Token name
apiTokens.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.

apiTokens.issued: Copy this token now. Rondyr only shows it once.
apiTokens.copyFailed: Could not copy the token. Select the token text to copy it.
apiTokens.confirmDescription: Requests using {{name}} (ending in {{suffix}}) will stop working immediately.

quotas.description: Limits apply across all forms in this organization and reset at midnight UTC.

policy.description: {{classifier}} classifies submissions for this organization. Custom settings apply to new classification runs.

hints.probableSpam: A message with a spam score at or above this value goes to review as probable spam.
hints.ambiguous: A message with a spam score at or above this value but below the probable spam threshold goes to review; this value cannot exceed that threshold.
hints.solicitation: A message with a sales outreach score above this value goes to review.
hints.lowRelevance: A message with a relevance score below this value goes to review, or is accepted with the Off-topic label if you accept off-topic submissions.

policy.invalid: Check that the thresholds are between 0 and 1 and that ambiguous spam is at or below probable spam.
policy.saveFailed: Could not save the classification settings. Try again.
policy.loadFailed: Could not load the classification settings.

origins.label: Allowed origins of the form {{name}}
origins.description: The sites whose pages can submit this form from a browser. An empty list allows all sites.
origins.loadFailed: Could not load the allowed origins.
origins.empty: No origins: all sites are allowed.
origins.inUse: The redirect of this form points to this origin. Remove the redirect first.

refusals.invalid-origin: Enter a full origin, for example https://www.example.com.
refusals.wildcard: Wildcards are not accepted. Add each origin.
refusals.not-https: The origin must start with https://. Only localhost and loopback addresses accept http://.
refusals.credentials: Remove the username and password from the origin.
refusals.not-an-origin: Remove the path, the query and the fragment. Keep the scheme, the host and the port.

problems.notAdded: The origin could not be added. Try again.
problems.notRemoved: The origin could not be removed. Try again.

destinations.notSaved: The change could not be saved. Try again.
